source: Actual rendered-frame telemetry + separate rAF cadence from completed E2E run; that full run had one unrelated lazy-loading timeout.
limitations: Shared headless macOS environment; CPU/action timings include workload and automation overhead.
frameMs is an actual rendered frame interval sample, not a sustained GPU throughput measurement.
cpuMs measures CPU submission, not GPU completion.
GPU timer query unavailable in recorded environments.

measurements.note: Playwright end-to-end action times and requestAnimationFrame cadence; CPU submission and requestAnimationFrame cadence do not measure GPU completion or guarantee performance.
